# Test fixtures

Real public responses captured on 2026-10-17 during the source probe (Reddit Atom, Arctic Shift,
Bluesky searchPosts, FxTwitter, YouTube channel RSS, yt-dlp search, Google News, ESPN RSS, Google
Trends RSS, Sleeper trending), trimmed to a few items. They exist to test parsers against the real
field layouts. **They are fixtures, not current trends**: nothing derived from them should be
presented as a live discovery.
